name: GmpDeviationInvestigationManager
tagline: Report, classify, investigate and close GMP deviations on time – in one plug-and-play Power Platform control.
description: A complete GMP deviation module for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages: Minor/Major/Critical triage with a 30/15-day closure clock, product impact assessment, fishbone and 5-why root cause, CAPA linkage, recurrence detection and four-eyes QA approval – with gated workflow, KPIs and Power Fx events.
features: Minor / Major / Critical classification with automatic closure targets
Gated lifecycle: triage → root cause → impact + CAPA → QA approval
Product impact assessment with impacted batches
CAPA linkage, mandatory for Major/Critical and repeat deviations
Recurrence detection by category and area with hotspot chart
Closure clock with controlled extensions and rationale
Four-eyes QA approval with meaning of approval and effectiveness check
Root-cause Pareto, on-time closure and ageing KPIs
Bulk classify, assign, start investigation, CSV export
Phone layout at 320–375 px, keyboard and screen-reader support
